from machine import Pin, SPI
from max7219 import MAX7219
import time
spi = SPI(1, baudrate=1000000, sck=Pin({CLK}), mosi=Pin({DIN}))
d = MAX7219(spi, {CS})
time.sleep(1)
for r, row in enumerate([0x3C, 0x42, 0xA5, 0x81, 0xA5, 0x99, 0x42, 0x3C]):
    d._reg(r + 1, row)
while True:
    time.sleep(1)
